_comment: Auto-publish queue. The GitHub Action publishes queue[0] three times a week (Mon/Wed/Fri 09:00 UTC), then removes it. Newest-intended-first is NOT required; order = publish order (top publishes first). To add a post: write _drafts/<slug>.body.txt, add assets/images/og-<slug>.svg + rendered .png, and prepend/append an entry here. Fields: slug, title, description, og_title, og_desc, og_alt, tag (visible), cat (filter key: partnerships|growth|leadgen|operations|automation), read, summary (listing card).

queue.title: Founder-Led Sales: When to Do It and When to Hire
queue.description: Founder-led sales is a phase, not a strategy. When it's the right move, when it quietly caps growth, and the signals that say it's time to hire.
queue.og_title: Founder-Led Sales: When to Do It and When to Hire
queue.og_desc: When founder-led sales is right, when it quietly caps growth, and the signals that say it's time to hire.
queue.og_alt: Founder-Led Sales: When to Do It and When to Hire
queue.summary: Every founder ends up selling early, and that's fine. The mistake is missing the point where it stops being the right call and starts being the ceiling on growth.

queue.title: Outbound vs Inbound: Where to Point Your Effort First
queue.description: Outbound and inbound aren't rivals. They solve different problems at different speeds. How to know which one deserves your next hour, and how to run both together.
queue.og_title: Outbound vs Inbound: Where to Point Your Effort First
queue.og_desc: Outbound and inbound solve different problems at different speeds. How to know which one deserves your next hour.
queue.og_alt: Outbound vs Inbound: Where to Point Your Effort First
queue.summary: Ask five people whether to invest in outbound or inbound and you'll get five confident, opposite answers. The real answer depends on your stage, not your opinion.
